name: Desiree Santos
source:
Desiree in the middle child of two brothers. Her creative personality often left her feeling at odds with her more analytical family.
Having traveled a lot as a child, Desiree did not settle down until mid high school when they moved to be with her mother's family, leaving her with few close friends growing up.
At sixteen she lost her virginity to a long time crush on the patio of a friends house. The same night the boy also had sex with Desiree's friend, along with another girl whom he was secretly 'dating' at the time.
Since attending college, Desiree has grown rather popular in her classes but Vivian is the only person she hangs out with frequently.
